title: 1988 AHSME Problem 12
statement: Each integer \(1\) through \(9\) is written on a separate slip of paper and all nine slips are put into a hat. Jack picks one of these slips at random and puts it back. Then Jill picks a slip at random. Which digit is most likely to be the units digit of the sum of Jack’s integer and Jill’s integer?

solutions.text:
For a units digit of \(0,\) the ordered pairs are \((1,9),(2,8),\ldots,(9,1),\) giving \(9\) pairs. Each other units digit occurs \(8\) times among the \(81\) ordered pairs. Therefore \(0\) is most likely.

Thus the correct answer is A.
